release_notes: MBT POS v3.1.4 fully integrates Internal Consumption on desktop and the web dashboard. Select many products from a large searchable list, record them as one atomic department issue, and click any history record to see every product and quantity. Price snapshots preserve buying cost, weighted average buying cost, retail opportunity value and foregone gross profit. Managers and Admins can add, rename, archive and restore departments without losing history; Admin can void with PIN to restore stock and reverse accounting. Errors are shop-readable. Preserves AppData identity, license state and mbt_pos.db.
